title: Volkswagen
content: # Volkswagen. **Volkswagen AG** (German pronunciation:  ⓘ), commonly abbreviated to **VW**, is a German automobile manufacturer based in Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany. Established in 1937 by the German Labour Front, it was revived after World War II by British Army officer Ivan Hirst and, over the 81 years since, grew into the global brand it is today. As of 2025, the company had a market capitalization of approximately US$58.9 billion. The company is well known for the Beetle and serves as the flagship brand of its eponymous conglomerate "Conglomerate (company)"), the Volkswagen Group, which was the world's largest automotive manufacturer by global sales in 2016 and 2017. Volkswagen AG, commonly known as Volkswagen or VW, is a prominent German automotive manufacturer headquartered in Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony. Founded on May 28, 1937, by the German Labour Front, the company was initially established to produce an affordable "people's car" as envisioned by Adolf Hitler.
